verdict.rationale: Rive is a design editor with runtime libraries, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control in the Editor, the runtimes, the AI agent, or the MCP integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
